9bb4ede4fde4dace.description:
Who We Are
Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 400+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, our annual revenue is in the hundreds of millions USD and millions use our browser on Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, our search engine, and the DuckDuckGo subscription. We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai, which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place. 
 
Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!

Your Team and Role
Working on the Data Science Functional Team, you'll drive product and business impact by developing data scientists, setting clear expectations for them, providing hands-on mentorship, and removing blockers.

You will guide and advise multiple data science projects so that they stay on track and have timely delivery with maximum impact. These projects will involve statistical modeling, experiment design, and classifier implementation across our search engine, instant answers, AI, and revenue optimization. You'll collaborate cross-functionally to validate direction through data, build trust in organizational tactics and strategy by consulting on experiments, and become an expert in our core metrics like searches, installs, and revenue. You'll also drive improvement of the data pipeline. Because of our strong privacy policies, you'll need to think creatively and develop strategies for how we can surface more actionable insights in an evidence-first culture where quantitative rigor is the baseline, not the exception.

As a Director, Data Science, you'll help shape our all-in-one privacy solution and join our mission to show the world that protecting your privacy online can be simple. 

About You
• 
You have 10+ years of experience in data science or ML engineering, with 4+ years leading teams, and a track record of setting multi-team roadmaps and adapting swiftly as priorities shift.
• 
You've driven organizational culture toward data-driven decision-making and can translate technical tradeoffs and risks clearly for executives and cross-functional stakeholders.
• 
You enjoy coaching experienced data scientists who are already highly skilled. You give direct, actionable feedback and you've built teams where people do the best work of their careers.
• 
You can deploy and iterate ML and NLP solutions in production at expert level, with deep knowledge of when to reach for which tools - especially in constrained environments requiring fast responses and strict privacy standards.
• 
You write production-grade code in Python or a comparable high-level language and stay close to the technical work when it matters most.
• 
You have advanced SQL and query optimization skills, familiarity with columnar databases like BigQuery, Clickhouse, Redshift, or Druid.
• 
You have strong LLM/AI experience including fine-tuning, LLM-as-judge evaluation, and AI-assisted development, and can design, implement, and analyze experiments across product surfaces using sparse or privacy-constrained data.
• 
Preferred: experience at a consumer-facing tech company where data or analytics is core to the product strategy.

Compensation
This role is paid on a regional pay scale, in local currency, and stock options:
• 
United States: $263,300 USD annually
• 
United Kingdom: £183,850 GBP annually
• 
Canada: C$346,250 CAD annually
• 
Europe/Rest of World: €214,950 EUR annually
In Spain, pay is expected to transition to the EUR scale on January 1, 2027, and in other Europe/Rest of World countries on February 1, 2027.
 
Compensation is transparent across the organization, and all team members within the same professional level and global region receive the same compensation.
 
Our Team Member Support Guide explains how we prioritize your wellbeing including paid parental leave, office setup, and co-working allowances.

Hiring Process
Hiring works best when it's a two-way street. Learn how we help you get to know DuckDuckGo, envision your future role here, and find out more about how we hire.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion
DuckDuckGo provides equal work opportunities to all team members and applicants, and it prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, caste, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by our policies or federal, state, or local laws.

We want to ensure that our hiring process is accessible. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process because of a medical condition or disability, please send an email to 

Please note that:
• 
You’ll be required to attend meetings on camera via video conferencing
• 
Expect to travel at least two times a year: once for our all-hands meetup and again for a team retreat (each around 4-5 days). While extenuating circumstances may impact attendance, everyone is strongly encouraged to attend.
• 
While we offer a flexible work arrangement with no core hours, expect an average full-time commitment of 40 hours per week.
• 
A successful candidate must pass a background check as a condition of joining the team.
• 
By applying for this role, you confirm that all information submitted is accurate and complete. You further acknowledge that providing false or fraudulent information during the application process is cause for denial of an offer, revocation of any existing offer, or other adverse action, up to and including termination after the start of your commencement of work.

Disclosure Statement: Use of AI in Hiring Process
As part of our commitment to enhancing our recruitment process, we utilize artificial intelligence (AI) technology to assist in reviewing and summarizing job applications and test projects, including those tools integrated into our recruitment vendor platforms. We use AI to flag potentially fraudulent applications, analyze and summarize applicants’ experience, interviews, and project performance, and help streamline our selection process.

Key Principles:
• 
Data Privacy: All information provided in your application will be handled in accordance with our Recruiting Privacy Policy. We ensure that your personal information is protected and used solely for recruitment purposes.
• 
Human Oversight and Accountability: The AI technology is designed to support our hiring team by providing insights and summaries of applications and evaluations of test projects against scoring rubrics. All final evaluations and hiring decisions, however, will be made by our hiring team, who will consider the AI's input alongside other factors.
• 
Transparency: We believe in transparency regarding our hiring practices. If you have any questions about how AI is used in our recruitment process, please feel free to reach out to us.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge and consent to the use of AI technology in our review process. If you would like to request an alternative selection process, please contact us as at

Headquarters: Remote - Wisconsin, USA

Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

About the Role

We are looking for an Account Executive to join our Sales and Go-to-Market team. This role is based in the Wisconsin area, reporting to the Regional Director. You will be part of a global group of professionals passionate about delighting our customers, nurturing trusted partnerships, and sharing expertise to drive a secure, cloud-enabled digital future. By demonstrating the power and agility of cloud transformation, you will help cement our position as the world leader in cloud security.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

• Build relationships with important internal and customer stakeholders, including c-suite decision-makers.

• Create a long-term account strategy aligned with customer goals.

• Collaborate with internal teams to meet customer needs and contribute to comprehensive account planning.

• Act as a trusted advisor by understanding client businesses and aligning technical solutions with their strategic goals.

Who You Are (Success Profile)

• You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.

• You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.

• You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.

• You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.

• You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

• Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving.

• 5+ years of full-cycle sales experience within the software or security industry.

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

• Progressive selling experience engaging with enterprise accounts and selling at the C-Level.

• Residency in or willingness to commute within the greater Wisconsin area. 

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

• Effectively leverage LLMs and Generative AI tools to boost productivity and sales effectiveness across research, prospecting, customer prep, and opportunity management.

• Established relationships with current and prospective customers and a deep understanding of how technology facilitates high-level business goals.

• Proficiency in strategic sales planning with a proven track record of closing net new logos.

• Experience meeting or exceeding sales targets while leveraging channel partnerships.

Zscaler’s salary ranges are benchmarked and are determined by role and level. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations and could be higher or lower based on a multitude of factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

The base salary range listed for this full-time position excludes commission/ bonus/ equity (if applicable) + benefits.

$120,750—$172,500 USD

At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure.

9b437b11acd25468.description: The Agency Fund invests in innovations that harness human agency to improve social welfare and economic development. We back fast-growing technology nonprofits across the globe, working in health, education, livelihoods and citizen services, most of them operating alongside government and reaching more than a million people each. In addition to funding, we embed experienced technical people inside them for one to two years to build what they need. The results: Rocket Learning went from 200,000 to 4 million children served, with cost per unit of impact falling from between $30 and $100 down to under $2. Noora Health scaled from 7 million to 30 million patients, with cost per patient falling from $9.33 to around $2. Our portfolio includes One Acre Fund, Digital Green, Noora Health, Youth Impact, Jacaranda Health and Living Goods, across India, East Africa and West Africa. Since 2022 we have moved 18 technical professionals from industry into the social sector. Our goal is 50 a year. **The Role** We’re looking for a **Technical Talent Partner** to join our Operations Team. You will bring people who have built products at scale in industry into organizations where their work changes what happens to millions of people. You will hire for our own technical team, and for the organizations we fund, many of whom are hiring their first engineer, product manager, or data lead. We have hired people from Google, Meta, Zepto, Spacelift and Atlas AI. The role exists to keep doing that at scale: moving experienced technical people out of industry and embedding them with highly effective social sector organizations that are ready for change. **What You’ll Do** - **Map the market and find the people.** Know which companies produce the profile we need, what makes them consider a move, and what our pitch has to overcome. Use AI across the whole funnel: mapping talent pools, surfacing non-obvious candidates, drafting outreach, and doing it at scale. - **Screen with judgment.** Work out how much of what an application claims the candidate personally owned. Run a conversation that establishes what they built, which decisions were theirs, and what they would change if they did it again. Candidates know what a job description is asking for and will tell you they have it, so the skill is getting to evidence rather than assertion. - **Partner with hiring managers.** Agree the role definition and the hiring bar. Challenge a role specification that does not describe what the team actually needs. Calibrate your screening against our tech team’s judgment so that one standard applies. While the assessment of technical depth stays with the tech team, you will filter the promising candidates to the tech round. - **Build the referral engine.** Half our hires should come through referrals, and every person we hire should refer someone. Build it into the process, and grow our candidate roster several times over. - **Run the events.** Shape and run events with VCs and technical communities in India, Kenya, Nigeria, South Africa and the US. - **Own the compensation conversation.** We do not compete with industry on salary, and most of the people we want have never heard of the organizations we fund. Building the case for this work, and putting it in front of people before they are looking for a job, is a core part of this role. - **Run the process and close.** Communicate promptly and keep candidates moving. Handle counteroffers. Keep people warm between offer and start date. - **Build the playbook.** Track where candidates come from, where they drop, how long each stage takes. Use that to fix what is not working, and document what we learn so the next search starts ahead of the last one. **Who You Are** **Required** - 5+ years recruiting technical roles, at least 2 of them in-house at a product company. - You can hold a conversation with an engineer or product manager about what they built and you know when an answer is thin. - You have designed your own screening questions and you can explain what each one was testing for. - Strong sourcing in Indian technical markets. - You have built something with AI that changed how you work. You can describe what you automated, what it saved you, and where it got things wrong. - Comfortable working with several hiring managers at once, with different standards and different budgets. **Helpful** - Sourcing experience in African markets. - A technical background of any depth, even informal. - Experience recruiting for an organization that was not the highest bidder, or not yet well known in its market. **How we work** - Async-first, fully remote. About Zeta
Build the future of banking.
Zeta is a next-generation banking technology company providing cloud-native, fully stackable processing and core banking platforms for issuers. With a focus on scalability, compliance, and innovation, Zeta empowers financial institutions to modernize their technology infrastructure and deliver secure, seamless digital banking experiences.
Our impact runs at real-world scale. Today, over 25 million cards are live on Zeta-powered platforms across 7 countries, supported by a passionate team of 1,700+ Zetanauts across India, the US, EMEA, and Asia. Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, Mastercard, and other reputed strategic investors, we reached a valuation of $2 billion in 2025.
Our focus is on establishing product lines that focus on key outcomes by addressing real customer pain points, modernizing legacy systems, and strengthening core fundamentals. As a result, our systems and platforms support a wide range of banking and payments capabilities, including:
1. Tachyon, our cloud-native banking stack built for population-scale systems
2. Cipher, our unified authentication platform for secure, high-volume banking environments
3. Digital Credit as a Service, enabling banks to launch credit lines on UPI
4. Elena, our intelligent and conversational AI platform for banking
5. Pixel, India’s first digital-native credit card, launched in partnership with HDFC Bank, for whom we also revamped their PayZapp mobile app: Winner of the Celent Model Bank Award for Payments Innovation 2024
6. Sparrow, the leading card experience for non-prime cardholders in the US…and more across cards, payments, lending, and core banking.
We are an engineering-first organization that values ownership, bias for action, and long-term thinking. Together, we solve some of the hardest problems in banking tech. Our culture is built around trust, collaboration, and creating the conditions for you to drive impact proportionate to your potential. Reinforcing our commitment to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace, we have been consistently recognized as a Great Place to Work.
If you want to build cutting-edge banking tech that enables banks to serve millions reliably, securely, and at a population scale, Zeta is your playground.
If you would like to learn more about how we have grown and evolved over the years, watch our journey here. You can also explore our website and follow us on LinkedIn, Instagram,YouTube, and X.
 
About the Product
Zeta is building a new consumer banking product for the US market. The focus is learning fast which features drive adoption, engagement and retention — and building them well.
 
About the Role
You'll help grow the product through a steady cadence of experiments and feature launches. Each PM owns a business-outcome metric for one area of the product, and the roadmap that moves it. Example areas: onboarding and activation, engagement and retention, revenue, and trust and risk.
We need a hustler. The work will feel like a very early-stage startup: ambiguous problems, incomplete information, shifting priorities and no playbook. You'll bring structure to the chaos: find the answers, make the calls and get things shipped.
We expect PMs to use AI tools across the lifecycle — research, specs, prototyping, analysis — to keep iteration cycles short. PMs here go deep on how things are built, so hands-on software development experience is mandatory.


Responsibilities
1. Own a metric

• Own a business-outcome metric for your area, plus the guardrail metrics it must not trade away.

• Keep a ranked backlog of experiments and features, prioritised by expected impact (RICE, ICE or similar).

2. Run experiments

• Write each bet as a hypothesis with a primary metric, guardrails and a decision rule, all set before launch.

• Match the method to the traffic: A/B tests and holdouts at scale; fake doors, usability tests and cohort analysis at low volume.

• Size tests properly, report null and negative results as plainly as wins, and make the ship, iterate or kill call.

• Keep a running log of what was tested, what was learned and what changed.

3. Build features

• Take features from problem definition through spec, build, QA, launch and adoption.

• Write specs engineers can build from: flows, edge cases, failure states, event instrumentation and acceptance criteria.

• Work through technical design with engineering — APIs, data models, ledger and payment flows, third-party integrations — and make trade-off calls quickly.

4. Measure

• Define output metrics (acquisition, activation, revenue, engagement) and the input metrics that drive them (funnel conversion, feature usage).

• Own event instrumentation and data quality for your area.

• Do your own analysis in SQL, product analytics tools (such as Mixpanel, Amplitude or MoEngage) and BI tools (such as Metabase or Superset).

5. Research users

• Run continuous discovery with US customers through remote interviews, usability tests and surveys.

• Turn what you hear and what the data shows into clear problem statements that feed the backlog.

6. Shape the UX

• Partner with designers on simple flows that earn users' trust.

• Own product copy for your area.

7. Launch and support

• Ship behind feature flags and in stages, with monitoring and a rollback plan.

• Work with compliance, risk, banking partners, operations and support so every launch meets regulatory requirements and can be supported from day one.

Skills
• Statistics and experiment design: hypothesis testing, significance, power and sample sizing, and common traps such as peeking and novelty effects.

• Strong SQL, and fluency with product analytics and BI tools.

• Ability to work through messy data sets and turn them into decisions.

• Engineering fundamentals you still use: reading code, system design, APIs and data models.

• A keen eye for design, and strong UX writing.

• Clear written and verbal communication — specs and experiment readouts people can act on.

• Meticulous program management across parallel workstreams.

• Hands-on experience with user research.

Experience and Qualifications
• 6+ years of total experience, including: 3–4 years in product management, with features shipped and measured in production. At least 3 years of hands-on software development, writing and shipping production code as an engineer. This is mandatory.

• A track record of experiments that changed a product decision.

• Preferred: consumer fintech, payments or banking experience, ideally in the US.

• Preferred: B2C products with a growth or experimentation focus.

9b4be0c755fd255c.description: Start your career in finance with Morgan Stanley as a Investment Banking Analyst Intern in Thiruvananthapuram. You will sit with a working investment bank team, use the same systems and reports they do, and own a defined piece of work from day one. About the role As a Investment Banking Analyst Intern at Morgan Stanley, your core focus will be financial modelling, valuation and pitch-book preparation for live deals. You will be attached to a named mentor, join the team's daily stand-ups and reviews, and be trusted with work that genuinely matters rather than filing and formatting. Questions are encouraged, mistakes are treated as teaching moments, and your output is reviewed properly so you actually improve. What you'll do day to day Support financial modelling, valuation and pitch-book preparation for live deals alongside the core investment bank team Work in Excel and the company's internal systems on live financial data Prepare schedules, reconciliations and reports that go to real reviewers Research companies, customers, products or regulations as the work demands Turn your analysis into clear notes and decks for senior stakeholders Follow the documentation and control standards a regulated business requires Take part in reviews, ask questions and act on the feedback you receive Skills you'll build You will build practical, demonstrable experience in Financial Modelling, Valuation (DCF & Comparables), MS Excel, PowerPoint / Pitch Books, Company Research, M&A Fundamentals, Accounting Fundamentals, Capital Markets, Analytical Thinking, Business Writing the exact toolkit that separates a hireable finance fresher from a CV full of coursework. No prior work experience is required. Curiosity, numerical comfort and care with detail matter far more here than a polished rsum, and every one of these skills is taught on the job. Who should apply Students in their final year or recent graduates from MBA (Finance)/CFA L1/CA/B.Com (Hons)/BBA based in or willing to work from Thiruvananthapuram. You should be comfortable with numbers, willing to learn Financial Modelling, Valuation (DCF & Comparables), MS Excel, and able to communicate clearly in writing. Relevant coursework, certifications (NISM, CFA L1, GST, Tally) or a strong academic record in Financial Modelling will strengthen your application, but none of them are mandatory. Internship details This is a 3-month internship in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, with a stipend of 43,000 per month. You will be given a defined project so that you leave with a valuation model and pitch deck for a real transaction. Working hours follow the team's normal business hours and the internship includes a certificate on successful completion. You will finish this internship able to read a set of financial statements with confidence, work comfortably in Excel at speed, and explain exactly how your work fed a real business decision. Strong performers are considered for a Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) and a full-time role. How to apply Click Apply Now. If you are not logged in you will be asked to sign in and register first, after which you will be taken to Morgan Stanley's official careers page to complete your application. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis and seats for this Financial Modelling-focused internship are limited, so apply early. Responsibilities: Support financial modelling, valuation and pitch-book preparation for live deals alongside the core investment bank team; Work in Excel and internal systems on live financial data; Prepare schedules, reconciliations and reports for senior review; Research companies, customers, products or regulations as required; Present analysis clearly in notes and decks for stakeholders; Follow documentation and control standards required in a regulated business. Requirements: Pursuing or recently completed MBA (Finance)/CFA L1/CA/B.Com (Hons)/BBA 2026 freshers & final-year students welcome; Working knowledge of Financial Modelling, Valuation (DCF & Comparables), MS Excel (or a genuine willingness to learn them); Strong numerical ability and comfort working in MS Excel; Care with detail and the discipline to document work properly; Clear written and verbal communication in English; Based in or willing to work from Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala. .
